title: SPI Transmit
text: Transmit data through Serial Peripheral Interface (SPI) on target, 1 input, 1 output, {SPI module} sets SPI module to write data; {Clock polarity} sets the sPI clock polarity, {Clock phase} sets the sPI clock phase, {Enable blocking mode} sets the sPI blocking mode enable, {Data bits} sets the number of bits in SPI transfer, {Chip select calling method} sets the method to select SPI peripheral device Provided by the SPI, {Chip select pin polarity} sets the sPI chip select pin polarity and {Chip select pin} sets the sPI peripheral select pin. Values come from the instance.

params.name: SPI module
params.values: SPI module to write data SPI_A (default) | SPI_B | SPI_C | SPI_D

params.name: Enable blocking mode
params.values: SPI blocking mode enable off (default) | on

params.name: Data bits
params.values: Number of bits in SPI transfer 8 (default) | integer in [1 16]

params.name: Chip select calling method
params.values: Method to select SPI peripheral device Provided by the SPI peripheral (default) | Explicit GPIO calls

params.name: Chip select pin polarity
params.values: SPI chip select pin polarity Active low (default) | Active high

params.name: Chip select pin
params.values: SPI peripheral select pin 0 (default) | positive integer scalar
